reason: The policy requires authenticating identity via email or name+zip before any account-specific help, even when the user already supplied identifying info. The user supplied an email address and the assistant is calling find_user_id_by_email with that exact email to perform the mandated authentication step. No database-mutating action or disclosure occurs here; this is purely the required identity lookup.
policy_references: you have to authenticate the user identity by locating their user id via email, or via name + zip code. This has to be done even when the user already provides the user id.
